decisions.statement: A tree is built by the builder that already built the tree rather than by new code.
The pages tree spells a document as the checkout and the path inside parted by a colon.
A commands row has the words that command is called by.
A commands row has the definition that command's own page states.
Every row of every tree has the same four names for the same four facts.
A row names a document by a whole path rather than a path the editor must join.
A row that opens no document names none.
A domains row has its champion as the description the panel draws.
A work row has the kind that row is among the work tree's three kinds.
A tree whose rows reach no single row of their own is given one to hang under.
The row given that way is keyed `root` and carries the kind `root`.
The row given that way is labelled by what the panel holding it is named.
The row given that way opens no document and has no color.
The subagents under a seat are the subagent pages naming that seat.
A subagent page is joined onto its seat's row through the seat's name.
A subagent page naming a seat no row answers to is left out.
A subagent row is labelled by the kind that subagent was dispatched as.
A subagent stating no kind is labelled by the id that subagent runs under.
Every subagent hangs directly under its seat rather than under another subagent.
A subagent row says whether that subagent was stopped from the panel.
No seat is counted as unread.
Reading a seat's turn banks how far that seat's transcript was read.
A field the builder adds reaches the editor only where the field is named here too.
Nothing here reads a clock or watches a file.
Nothing here starts a child process.
Nothing here folds a transcript for the subagents a seat is running.
No tree made from the pages alone is here; a landing carries those.

definition: each tree the editor draws put into the one row every tree has
